name: Limin Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Limin Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of fungicides, insecticides, and herbicides in China. The company offers technical, single formulation, and mixture of fungicide, insecticide, herbicide, nematicide, and acaricide. It also provides veterinary drugs, including Azoxystrobin 97% TC, Captan 95% TC, Chlorothalonil 98% TC, Cymoxanil 98% TC, Cyprodinil 95% TC, Difenoconazole 95% TC, Famoxadone 98% TC, Folpet 95% TC, Fosetyl-al 96% TC, Mancozeb 88% TC, Mancozeb 96% TC, Metiram 85% TC, Metiram 87% TC, Metiram 87% TC, Propineb 89% TC, Pyraclostrobin 97.5% TC, Pyraclostrobin 98% TC, Pyrimethanil 95% TC, Trifloxystrobin 97% TC, and Zineb 90% TC.
